scripts.dev:server: bun run --cwd apps/auth serve & bun run --cwd apps/api serve
scripts.deploy:sandbox: wrangler deploy -c apps/auth/wrangler.jsonc -e sandbox && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc -e sandbox
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler deploy -c apps/auth/wrangler.jsonc -e production && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc -e production
